targets.evidence_quote: This paper reports an approximate replication of Matsuda and Gobel (2004) for the psychometric validation of the Foreign Language Reading Anxiety Scale (FLRAS).
targets.outcome_quote: Matsuda and Gobel's conclusions were reproduced by showing a weak relationship between classroom performance and foreign language reading anxiety measured by the three-factor model of the FLRAS.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly says the original conclusions were reproduced. The new reading-proficiency association is presented as a new result, rather than a failed original comparison.
